channel.title: Vienna Public Transport — Disruptions & Commuter Info

item.title: 18: LCC autumn marathon on 11.10.2026
item.description: Due to the LCC autumn marathon in Prater Hauptallee, line 18 is curtailed. Line 18: service only between Burggasse, Stadthalle U and Schlachthausgasse U. [Today]
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Wien Hetzendorf ↔ Wien Atzgersdorf
item.description: Due to damage on the track, trains could only run to a limited extent until 00:42. For now, allow up to 10 minutes of extra travel time. [Today]
